query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE workflow_runs SET project_id = $2, definition_id = $3, state = $4 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO workflow_run_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($5, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $6, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($7::TEXT[], $8::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
